Standard_Hearing.description: Baseline auditory perception within normal atmospheric frequencies.

Acute_Hearing.description: Highly sensitive auditory canals for detecting faint sounds (e.g., Canines, Felines).

Directional_Pinna.description: Asymmetrical or mobile ears that can perfectly pinpoint sound origin (e.g., Owls, Foxes).

Echolocation.description: Active emission of sound waves to map surroundings (e.g., Bats, Dolphins).

Tremorsense.description: Detection of minute vibrations through solid surfaces (e.g., Spiders, Burrowing Rodents, Worms).

Infrasonic_Hearing.description: Detection of extremely low-frequency sounds over vast distances (e.g., Elephants, Whales).

Aquatic_Acoustics.description: Tuned to the rapid transmission of sound waves through liquid (e.g., Marine Life).
